entries.note: Listed in the tracker page's own script (tk-kit.ru tracking.js): the order is created.
Listed in the tracker page's own script (tk-kit.ru tracking.js): the cargo is accepted at the origin terminal.
Listed in the tracker page's own script (tk-kit.ru tracking.js): the cargo has left; some routes skip this step.

Listed in the tracker page's own script (tk-kit.ru tracking.js): the cargo is at the terminal in the consignee's city, where paid storage applies; on routes with delivery the script says a logistician will arrange it and F3 follows.
Listed in the tracker page's own script (tk-kit.ru tracking.js): taken for delivery to the address or to a pickup point; only routes with delivery show it.
Listed in the tracker page's own script (tk-kit.ru tracking.js): issued to the consignee.
Listed in the tracker page's own script (tk-kit.ru tracking.js): the order is cancelled.
Heading of the tracker page's block shown when the sender has barred issue; the cargo keeps moving but is held at the destination until the sender lifts the bar.
